issues.problem: Misuse 1 (路上很滑，你要小心翼翼！) is only awkward, not clearly wrong: 你要小心翼翼地走 is fine, so a native speaker would not reject it outright.
issues.action: Replaced with a shouted warning (小心翼翼！后面有车开过来了！), which is clearly wrong; reason rewritten. Story (诗经·大雅·大明, 维此文王，小心翼翼) checked and kept.

issues.problem: Context 6 (说明书我读了两遍，还是一知半解) fits 一窍不通 (cy036) equally well.
issues.action: Rewritten to 说明书我读了两遍，懂了一部分，可还是一知半解, so that partial understanding is stated; English updated. Story (严羽《沧浪诗话·诗辨》) checked and kept.
